title: uxc fd.script meta (fd/scripts/<id>/meta.json)
description: A JSAPI script stored as a Script-class document (fd.script). The content file sits next to this meta. Only name, acl, registrationOrder, contentFile and classId are read; other keys are ignored by push but show as drift.

$schema.description: Editor hint only: uxc ignores it (never hashed, never pushed).

registrationOrder.description: RegistrationOrder tag as an integer STRING, inside the manifest band (lower loads earlier). Without it the GUI never loads the script. null, spelled out, = a server-only library a handler load()s at run time (no tag).

contentFile.description: File name of the script next to meta.json (default "<id>.js").

classId.description: Server-only library only (registrationOrder null): store the document under this class so the GUI never downloads it. Omit it for a Script document; "Script" itself is refused.
